claims.statement: For every supplied sorted middle witness in the stated domain, the ordered mixed-source fibre is exactly the disjoint E/M union in equations Efibre, Mfibre and fibrecount.
claims.proof: core.tex: complete bare fibre theorem and proof
claims.scope: A target may have an empty fibre; no witness at every prime is inferred.

claims.statement: Known p and the full labelled receiver matrix recover the returned target and its four selected square-root branches on the receiver image.
claims.scope: The inverse does not choose an arithmetic preimage when the source fibre is nontrivial.

claims.statement: The fixed-positive-(R,u) middle family has singular powers 9, 4, 3/2 and -3/2 with the four displayed first relative coefficients and the inverse-compound limits in the theorem.
claims.proof: core.tex: middle spectrum with first corrections
claims.scope: The remainders hold for fixed R,u and do not assert uniformity in unbounded parameters.

claims.statement: The scalar heat observation powers for the fixed-(R,u) middle family are exhaustively 0, 2, 3 and 9.
Two reduced prime progressions in the class 1 modulo 840 make the three inherited inverse powers p^(3/2), 1 and p^(-2) sharp on actual middle witnesses.
claims.scope: Sharpness on the smaller mixed-return image is not claimed.

nonclaims: No universal source or witness existence theorem.
No proof or counterexample to the Erdős–Straus conjecture.
No historical-priority claim from the bounded literature search.
